integrations.trigger: PI initiates a literature-review tranche from an MCP client.
integrations.responsible_human_role: Principal investigator (PI); reads results, grades evidence, records adoption/refusal.
integrations.information_sent: Natural-language queries about published pathogen parameters and model evidence; no patient data or proprietary ship information.
integrations.information_returned: Ranked papers, abstracts, DOI metadata, and available excerpts.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Use only non-confidential scientific queries; institutional full-text access may be license-bound.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Exact query, timestamp, result list/DOIs, excerpts used, evidence grade, adoption/refusal decision, tranche document hash.
integrations.permitted_fallback: PubMed, Crossref, Google Scholar, or institutional library; preserve equivalent search log.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: If evidence needed for a parameter cannot be retrieved or adjudicated, mark parameter blocked/nonquotable; do not silently infer a source.

integrations.trigger: Push or pull request when live Sonar quality gate is required, or repository administrator enables/repairs GitHub App/token configuration.
integrations.responsible_human_role: GitHub/SonarCloud repository administrator; developers triage returned findings.
integrations.information_sent: Public repository source, workflow metadata, and coverage report to SonarCloud.
integrations.information_returned: Quality-gate status, code smells, duplication, coverage, vulnerabilities/security hotspots.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Administrator must authorize GitHub App/token; no private source or secrets may be sent unless repository policy explicitly permits it.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Analysis ID/URL, commit SHA, scanner version, quality-gate result, exported issue list, coverage input hash, admin configuration change record.
integrations.permitted_fallback: For local development only: Ruff, pytest, sonar_guard.py, Bandit, coverage. This is not evidence that the live SonarCloud gate passed.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: If a release/publication gate requires live Sonar, missing token/service is BLOCKED/nonzero. Otherwise log 'live Sonar not run' and execute the approved local gate; never report Sonar pass.

integrations.trigger: A campaign explicitly selects ContamX transport (not native/hobbyist), especially c13 comparison campaigns.
integrations.responsible_human_role: Licensed airflow/indoor-air engineer installs binary, verifies version/license, reviews .prj and mapping inputs.
integrations.information_sent: Local .prj multizone airflow project and associated schedules/path maps to the local proprietary executable; no external API transfer is required.
integrations.information_returned: Time-resolved airflow and contaminant transport outputs.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: ContamX license and platform-data authorization apply; restricted ship geometry must remain on an authorized host.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Binary version/hash/path, license/authorization record, .prj/path-map/input hashes, exact command, stdout/stderr, return code, output hashes, engineer sign-off.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Native/hobbyist Python transport only for campaigns predeclared for that engine; it is not numerically equivalent evidence for a ContamX comparison claim.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: Requested ContamX with missing/unapproved binary or restricted host must exit nonzero/BLOCKED; never silently substitute native transport.

integrations.trigger: After any manual or vision-model ship-digest stage, before synthesis of a new platform.
integrations.responsible_human_role: Authorized naval architect/engineer or data owner reviews each page_NN draft and creates page_NN_approved.svg.
integrations.information_sent: Draft digest/overlay and source drawing to the authorized reviewer; distribution limited by drawing classification.
integrations.information_returned: Approved SVG overlays, corrections, approval identity/date, limitations.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Export-control, classification, owner license, and need-to-know constraints. Restricted drawings remain within approved systems.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Original drawing hash and classification, draft and approved overlay hashes, reviewer identity/role, approval UTC, corrections, --require-approved validation log.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Manual platform construction from authorized measurements; mock provider only for software tests, never scientific geometry.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: Absent approved overlays must block synthesis nonzero when --require-approved is active. Publication geometry remains blocked without recorded approval.

integrations.trigger: Operator explicitly runs ship_blueprint_import digest with anthropic, gemini, or openai_compat provider.
integrations.responsible_human_role: Authorized operator selects provider/model, confirms data-release authorization, manages API credentials; human reviewer then approves overlays.
integrations.information_sent: Rasterized blueprint images plus structured extraction prompt to commercial API.
integrations.information_returned: Machine-generated ShipDigest JSON: zone polygons, deck levels, opening/HVAC hints; provider metadata.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: RESTRICTED SHIP DRAWINGS MUST NOT BE SENT TO EXTERNAL APIS WITHOUT AUTHORIZATION. API terms, retention, regional routing, export control, and owner confidentiality must be reviewed first.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Written authorization, provider/model/version, endpoint, prompt, request/image hashes, digest_meta.json, raw response if permitted, cost/request IDs, validation and human-approval record.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Authorized manual digitization; local approved model if available; mock provider only for tests.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: No authorization, uncertain classification, missing API key, provider error, invalid schema, or absent human approval => nonzero/BLOCKED. Never upload by default or silently use mock for a scientific platform.

integrations.trigger: Campaign is selected for cloud scale-out or S3 archival.
integrations.responsible_human_role: AWS administrator provisions least-privilege IAM/Batch/S3; execution operator submits; PI approves campaign freeze and reviews completeness.
integrations.information_sent: Frozen campaign/source/environment manifests, run specs, simulation inputs, container/image reference, and outputs/logs to authorized AWS resources.
integrations.information_returned: AWS job/attempt IDs, status/reason, CloudWatch logs, S3 version IDs/checksums, shard/per-run archives and manifests.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Least privilege, approved account/region/bucket/KMS key, no credentials in artifacts. Restricted platform data only in authorized cloud boundary.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: IAM policy/role ARN (no secrets), account/region, Batch environment/job definition revisions, image digest/SBOM, job and attempt IDs, CloudWatch logs, S3 URI/version/ETag/checksum/object-lock, per-run and fused-shard lineage.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Local execution for bounded campaigns with the same immutable manifest and provenance gates; local run is not AWS operational validation.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: Unauthorized IAM, missing immutable image/manifest, upload/download checksum mismatch, missing shard, failed job, or stale fingerprint => nonzero/BLOCKED. Do not mark file presence as success.

integrations.trigger: Any quotable Bayesian fit, simulation-based calibration, parameter recovery, or live parity gate.
integrations.responsible_human_role: Authorized compute administrator/operator provides CmdStan host/toolchain; statistician/PI predeclares and adjudicates diagnostics.
integrations.information_sent: Stan source, hashed data JSON, seeds, sampler settings, resource request; if remote, only authorized study/simulation data.
integrations.information_returned: Compiled executable, sampler CSVs, stdout/stderr, diagnostics, posterior summaries and predictive checks.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Host access and data-transfer authorization; protect any proprietary ship inputs. Record compiler/CmdStan versions and executable hashes.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Source/data/executable hashes, CmdStan/stanc/compiler/OS versions, exact argv, seed/chain, timestamps, all CSV/logs, Rhat/ESS/divergence/treedepth/E-BFMI, prior/posterior predictive checks, exit/status.
integrations.permitted_fallback: NumPy reference walker only for smoke/parity development, never as substitute for validated Stan inference; explicit --allow-skipped-fit only in non-quotable workflows.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: Missing CmdStan without explicit nonquotable skip => exit 2; failed fit => 1; diagnostic quality failure => 3/BLOCKED. Compilation success alone must not pass inference gate.

integrations.trigger: An approved, bounded implementation specification is assigned.
integrations.responsible_human_role: PI authorizes scope and repository access; developer/reviewer adjudicates implementation and pull request.
integrations.information_sent: Pinned baseline SHA, issue/spec, acceptance tests, permitted files, exclusions, and evidence requirements.
integrations.information_returned: Branch/PR, commit SHAs, change summary, test/static-analysis outputs, unresolved questions and limitations.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Repository permissions and branch policy apply; never include credentials or unauthorized restricted data.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Prompt/spec hash, task/session identifier, branch and commits, PR URL, diffs, test logs, review decisions, merge SHA.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Manual implementation against the same specification and evidence requirements.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: Scope ambiguity, baseline drift, unavailable required test, or failing acceptance criterion => stop/block; do not self-approve or merge silently.

integrations.trigger: A human developer elects to use Cursor for an approved implementation or refactor.
integrations.responsible_human_role: Human developer controls edits; PI/reviewer approves scientific semantics and merge.
integrations.information_sent: Relevant repository files, pinned spec, local context, and acceptance tests.
integrations.information_returned: Local edits/commits and developer-reviewed test evidence.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Confirm provider data policy before exposing proprietary code or restricted ship information; no secrets.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Model/client version if available, governing spec hash, commits/diff, test logs, human review record.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: Unreviewed generated edits cannot clear scientific or merge gates.

integrations.trigger: Pull request, protected-branch push, scheduled security scan, or release gate.
integrations.responsible_human_role: Repository security/CI administrator configures workflow; developer triages alerts; authorized reviewer dismisses or accepts risk.
integrations.information_sent: Repository source and build metadata to GitHub Actions/CodeQL under repository policy.
integrations.information_returned: Workflow run, SARIF results, alerts, severity and query metadata.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: GitHub permissions and retention policy; private/restricted source requires explicit authorization.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Workflow URL/run ID, SHA, CodeQL/action/query-suite versions, SARIF hash, alert disposition and rationale.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Local supported CodeQL database/query run if available; other scanners are complementary, not evidence of CodeQL pass.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: If CodeQL is a declared gate, unavailable or unresolved high-severity alerts => blocked; never substitute Sonar/Bandit silently.

integrations.trigger: A versioned manuscript and evidence package reaches the declared external-review gate.
integrations.responsible_human_role: PI authorizes submission, reviews returned critique, and adjudicates each recommendation.
integrations.information_sent: Manuscript, figures/tables, and only authorized supporting context; exclude restricted data and licensed full text unless permitted.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Review terms, retention, unpublished-work confidentiality, copyright, and data classification before upload.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Submitted manuscript hash/version, date, service/version/settings, raw response, recommendation triage, resulting diff/hash.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Independent human editorial/statistical review with an equivalent archived review-response ledger.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: No authorization or unavailable service => record not run; manuscript cannot claim this review gate passed.

integrations.trigger: A versioned manuscript and claim-to-evidence map reaches the declared external-review gate.
integrations.responsible_human_role: PI authorizes submission and adjudicates all findings; statistician/developer owns technical follow-up as assigned.
integrations.information_sent: Authorized manuscript/evidence package without credentials, restricted geometry, or impermissible full text.
integrations.information_returned: Critique, integrity/consistency findings, annotations, and recommendations.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Review provider terms, retention, confidentiality, copyright, and data classification.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Submitted artifact hashes, date, service/version/settings, raw report, issue-by-issue disposition, revision/campaign links and final hash.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Independent human methods/integrity review with equivalent evidence capture.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: Unavailable or unauthorized => explicit not-run status; unresolved critical finding blocks submission or requires documented qualification.

integrations.trigger: A workflow step names an MCP-hosted capability not directly available in the active environment.
integrations.responsible_human_role: PI/operator invokes the MCP from an authorized client and returns the result packet; system administrator manages connection and permissions.
integrations.information_sent: Minimal approved query/input defined by the step, with no secrets or restricted content unless explicitly authorized.
integrations.information_returned: Raw MCP response, tool/server identity, timestamp, citations/artifacts, and error status.
integrations.authorization_or_confidentiality: Server-specific authorization, data handling, and licensing must be checked before use.
integrations.evidence_to_preserve: Exact request, server/tool/version if exposed, timestamps, raw response, cited identifiers, attached-file hashes, human adjudication.
integrations.permitted_fallback: Named non-MCP method only if scientifically equivalent and predeclared; otherwise keep the step blocked.
integrations.required_stop_behavior: Never infer or fabricate an MCP result. Missing access => explicit human handoff or blocked status.
